title: The Letter B — B is for Bible
memory_verse: "Your word is a lamp to my feet." — Psalm 119:105
objective: Students will learn the letter B and its sound using the Bible word Bible.
content: Today we learn the letter B! The letter B makes the sound 'buh' like in the word Bible. Can you say 'buh'?
The Bible is God's special book! It tells us about God and how much He loves us. The Bible has wonderful stories and teaches us how to be kind and good.
B is also in the words Bird, Bear, and Boat. Can you make the 'buh' sound? B-B-Bible!
activity: Trace the letter B with your finger. Draw a picture of a Bible. Find things in the room that start with B.
discussion: What sound does the letter B make?
Can you name something that starts with B?
